body.statement: Freidling, Zhao, and Gao's Proposition~2 represents the selective reference by restricting and normalizing the known adaptive action law on actions producing the same selection, and gives its computability when the outcomes needed to recompute selection and the statistic on that support are imputable.

attestation.note: The orchestrator directive supplied the Proposition 2 computability scope; the stable primary-source handles are recorded in place of a verbatim transcription.
